description: The Marshall is a Made in Canada, made for the people, light-up the trails dual-suspension mountain bike. At its heart, the all-new 130mm travel aluminum frame delivers Split-Pivot performance and reliability with key features like Boost spacing, size-appropriate wheel sizes, a dropper post, polyurethane frame protection and a lifetime warranty—all in a more wallet-friendly package. Paired with a 140mm fork and reliable parts, the Marshall delivers no-fuss riding for no-nonsense riders.
